text: Okanagan trails: short descriptions from the Greater Vernon trail map, Tourism Kelowna, Visit Westside, Visit Penticton, Summerland.com and Kelowna.com on 150 bike trails around Vernon, Kelowna, West Kelowna, Penticton and Summerland, plus BC Parks' Okanagan Mountain Park hikes. 6 more trails show their source's level instead of an estimate, and 51 show which way they're ridden.
